intro: Tests forming wh- questions using do, does, did, or no auxiliary with be/have

items.q: ___ does she go to the gym?
items.why: 'When' asks about time; do/does needed with main verb.
'What' asks about food; did used for past tense question.
'Who' as subject; no auxiliary needed, verb follows directly.
Asking about a place of work; 'where' is correct wh- word.

parts.title: Complete the sentences with the correct form.

items.why: Past tense question; 'did' required with main verb.
'Who' as subject with be; no auxiliary, just 'is'.

items.post: she buy her coffee every morning?

items.why: Past tense question; 'did' needed regardless of subject.
Present question; third-person singular subject takes 'does'.

parts.title: Find and correct the mistake in each sentence.

items.sentence: Where did she went on holiday?
items.corrected: Where did she go on holiday?
items.why: After 'did', the main verb must be in base form.
'Who' as subject; no auxiliary needed before the verb.

items.sentence: What time do he start work?
items.corrected: What time does he start work?

parts.title: Write your own sentences.
parts.pointsLabel: 2 points: 1 for correct form, 1 for meaning and use

items.prompt: Write a question asking a friend what time they usually wake up in the morning.
items.criteria: Correct wh- word 'what time', correct use of 'do/does', base form verb.
items.example: What time do you usually wake up in the morning?

items.prompt: Write a question asking what your friend did last Saturday evening.
items.criteria: Correct wh- word 'what', correct use of 'did', base form verb, past context.
items.example: What did you do last Saturday evening?
